name: Microsoft Copilot (copilot.microsoft.com)
siteVersion: cmc (surface) / 10f62a4-prod (errorReportConfig version); bundles entry-ssr-j2VGbmp2.js, vendor-DnpqayAT.js, msal-baCNE5FO.js

transport.protocol: JSON text frames; out {event:'send',conversationId,content:[...],mode:'chat'|'research'}; in {event:'appendText'/'replaceText'/'done'/'challenge'/...}; heartbeat {event:'ping'}/{event:'pong'}
transport.status: verified (static bundles); wire handshake + challenge outcome to-confirm-live
transport.note: The ui2api ChatDriver sends via the site's own UI path (type + Enter on #userInput); the WS described here is what that UI drives and is the floor-truth for a future raw transport.

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer (#userInput, Enter); streamed answer appends in-page. Underlying wire = WebSocket /c/api/chat (event:send → appendText/replaceText ... done) — verified in bundles
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)

capabilities.name: Web search / grounding mode
capabilities.description: Composer chat mode 'search' (Bing) — grounded answers with citation events on the wire
capabilities.method: ui-mode toggle (wire mode map verified: 'cs' → search)

capabilities.name: Think deeper (reasoning) mode
capabilities.description: Composer chat mode 'Think deeper' — reasoning tokens via chainOfThought events
capabilities.method: ui-mode toggle (wire mode map verified: 'td' → reasoning)

capabilities.name: Conversation history / persistence
capabilities.description: REST /c/api/conversations CRUD + /conversations/{id}/history?api-version=2; autotitle via titleUpdate events
capabilities.method: in-page REST (api-version=2; Authorization Bearer when authed)

capabilities.name: Image generation (Imagine)
capabilities.description: Image gen over the chat socket (generatingImage/imageGenerated events) with /imagine gallery; Bing Image Creator pipeline
capabilities.method: ui-path + in-band WS events (pipeline verified, endpoint to-confirm-live)

auth.note: Anonymous flows use a temporary session key (socket query temporarySessionKey + header X-Copilot-TemporarySessionKey). Optional MSAL sign-in (login.microsoftonline.com consumers/organizations) adds accessToken to the WS query and Authorization header. Cookies for consent/MSCC only; exact cookie set captured at first live capture.
auth.antiBot: Cloudflare Turnstile (in-band challenge event) + hashcash SHA-256 proof-of-work; first socket connect on a clean IP likely requires answering the challenge

analysisMethod: static curl + JS-bundle reading (4 bundles, ~2.8 MB: entry-ssr 1.57MB + vendor 0.88MB + msal 0.37MB + hashcash worker 1KB); no browser launched; host returned full SSR HTML (not bot-walled)
